answer: Every AI node carries a prism‑shaped credential minted only after staking a relic token and completing a crystal‑sealed proof of work. New entrants must solve a hash puzzle bound to that credential; the solution is broadcast and any duplicate or unsolved proof is discarded by the network. Thus an attacker must spend a relic per fake identity and repeat the costly puzzle for each, making large Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
